requirements.title: CODEX editorial bot classification and maturity exclusion
requirements.delta: Within CODEX, editorial-only automated PRs must be explicitly classified and excluded from functional maturity and defect-burndown metrics.
requirements.rationale: Proves approved local override precedence on a non-engineering operational requirement.
